messages:
yasmin: small UX idea: console could show an "expected units" preview when you paste a sample embeddings payload. saves back-and-forth with support.

ollie: love that. should also show the dominant shape (frames x dims) and an estimated route: fastpath vs slowpath.

dean: make it interactive: users can toggle a "rows" vs "chunks" hint and see cost + latency estimate change in real-time.

frank: telemetry-wise we emit `embed.preview.units_estimate` when preview generated (no payload stored). helps us understand before/after behavior. mark as non-sensitive.

yasmin: implementation plan: small preview service that runs client-side parsing + unit calc in the Console backend; no request forwarded to runtime. behind FF initially.

ingress-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "embed-preview-units" enabled on dev-console.

ollie: docs: add snippet for CLI and SDK to compute units so customers can preview locally.

dean: ok action items: yasmin prototype Console panel, frank add telemetry metric, ollie update docs. We'll canary the FF and measure `embed.ingress.413_rate` and preview usage.
